description: 1933 is the Year of the Water Rooster in the Chinese zodiac, from January 26, 1933 to February 13, 1934. Personality, Lunar New Year dates and numerology.
answer: In Chinese astrology, 1933 is the Year of the Water Rooster, a Yin year. It began at Lunar New Year on January 26, 1933 and ended on February 13, 1934, so people born in 1933 before Jan 26 belong to the Water Monkey year.

sections.heading: When the 1933 Water Rooster year starts and ends
paragraphs: The 1933 Water Rooster year began at Lunar New Year on January 26, 1933 and lasted until February 13, 1934, the day before the next new year. Anyone born between January 1 and Jan 26 1933 therefore belongs to the Water Monkey year that started in 1932, while someone born in early 1934, up to Feb 13, is still a Water Rooster. The Chinese calendar is lunisolar, which is why the start date moves between January 21 and February 20 instead of staying on January 1. The same Water Rooster combination also falls in 1993, sixty years apart, because five elements and twelve animals realign only once in each sixty-year cycle. Lunar New Year 1933 fell on a Thursday, while the Western Sun was in Aquarius.

sections.heading: Water Rooster personality
paragraphs: A Water Rooster year is linked with articulate, observant and curious people. The Rooster's Metal feeds Water, so traditional readings describe a precise mind softened by sensitivity, often gifted at writing, teaching or analysis. They tend to explain complicated ideas clearly. Overthinking is the usual caution, and readings suggest giving analysis a deadline before it turns into worry. Libraries, classrooms and editing desks often feel like home to them.

Water is the element of winter, stillness and depth, and a Water year is traditionally said to give any animal intuition, flexibility and a gift for communication. Descriptions associate it with wisdom, empathy and the ability to find a way around obstacles rather than through them. Water-year people are often portrayed as perceptive listeners, diplomatic and quietly persuasive, able to sense the mood of a room before anyone speaks. The element is linked with reflection and with the unseen, so it adds an inward, thoughtful layer. Its shadow, in most readings, is drift: indecision, secrecy, and a tendency to take on the shape of whoever is nearby.

sections.heading: 1933 in numerology and the twelve-year cycle
paragraphs: In numerology the year reduces to 7, the number of reflection, analysis and inner work, giving a 7 year a quieter, more searching character. The digits of 1933 add up to 16, which reduces to 7. In the twelve-year cycle the Rooster is the tenth animal, earthly branch You, with Metal as its fixed element and Yin polarity. The year element is Water, and in the five-element cycles metal generates Water. The year before was the Water Monkey and the year after is the Wood Dog.

In the traditional sexagenary count the year is called Gui-You: Gui is the Water heavenly stem and You is the Rooster's earthly branch. Stems and branches alternate between yang and yin together, which is why yin stems only ever meet yin animals.

faq.question: What Chinese zodiac is 1933?
faq.answer: 1933 is the Year of the Water Rooster. It started on January 26, 1933 and ended on February 13, 1934.

faq.question: What if I was born in January or February 1933?
faq.answer: Check the date against Jan 26. Born before January 26, 1933, you are a Water Monkey; born on or after it, you are a Water Rooster.

faq.question: What element is 1933 in the Chinese zodiac?
faq.answer: Water, a Yin year. The Rooster's own fixed element is Metal; the year element changes every two years, while the fixed element stays with the animal.

faq.question: What is the traditional Chinese name for 1933?
faq.answer: Gui-You. The first part is the heavenly stem, which carries the year's element and polarity; the second is the earthly branch, which carries the animal. Almanacs, calendars and Four Pillars charts identify years this way rather than by animal alone.

faq.question: When is the next Water Rooster year?
faq.answer: 1993, sixty years later, when the five elements and twelve animals line up again; the table also has 1993.
